project.title: Corporate Private Cloud (Data Centre Architecture)

parentsummary.deliverables: Designed and deployed a multi-petabyte corporate private cloud architecture leveraging Tier II and III data centres with NexentaStor software-defined storage, incorporating cross-business-unit data archival and retention policies, an access control model, and alignment to ISO:27001, NERC, FISMA, and NIST.
parentsummary.outcomes: Delivered a production-grade private cloud capable of handling multi-petabyte data archiving and retention for a geospatial engineering organization, achieving ISO:27001, NERC, FISMA, and NIST compliance across all storage and access control components.

challenge.summary: As a multi-petabyte data handling organization, GeoDigital required a robust solution for handling data archiving, data retention, and data integrity.

deliverables: Project Management using hybrid Agile & Waterfall methodologies
Stakeholder reporting and meetings with Executive teams and operations teams
Needs analysis, define requirements for project
Advisory services for technology selection and cloud provider integrations
Architectural design and lightweight PoC implementation
Security Coordination and alignment to required Guidelines (NERC, FISMA & NIST)
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls. Compliance required for ISO:27001, NERC and NIST
Engaged all business units to capture data archival, retention, and integrity requirements
Defined the private cloud access control model
Vendor Selection Advisory and Vendor Engagement

outcomes: ✅ Architected and deployed multi-petabyte corporate private cloud leveraging Tier II and III data centres with NexentaStor software-defined storage
✅ Achieved ISO:27001, NERC, FISMA, and NIST compliance
